title: Normalized evaluation of the actual strict tower square mate
statement: For four small ringed tensor corners, exact edges, a ring-compatible square s, normalized strict coefficient data q, normalized direct image/limit data dg,dh and normalized tower adjunctions ag,ah [def-sbc-strict-augmented-coefficient-presentation], evaluation at any index n carries the actual square mate towerMate at input q K to the ambient square mate s.exchange at the evaluated input. Explicitly evX(towerMate(input q K)) followed by evaluatedTarget equals evaluatedSource followed by s.exchange(evT(input q K)) [def-sbc-strict-coefficient-exchange-arrows]. No perfectness, projection isomorphism or completeness is required.

proof.text: Use the exact evaluation and pullback composition isomorphisms. The ordinary cube commutes because evaluation of termwise pullback is the strict identity and evaluation of the given square is s.modules. Exact derived localization preserves this cube. The representative normalization and uniqueness of s.derivedComparison identify its ambient face.

proof.text: The normalized Hom formulas determine the tower adjunction units on localized complexes, hence determine the tower adjunctions. The ordinary counit normalization determines the ambient adjunction counits on K-injective representatives. Apply uniqueness of normalized derived evaluation to identify the recorded direct-image evaluation comparisons with those preserving these counits.

proof.text: Apply the mate-cube identity to the inverse-image cube and substitute these counit-preserving comparisons. Reassociate the evaluation isomorphisms: their source composite is evaluatedSource and their target composite is evaluatedTarget. This is the displayed equality of evaluated morphisms.

theorem strictTowerMateEvaluation
    (s : RingedTensorSquare S T X Y g f e h) (q : Coefficients f g h e s)
    (ag : TowerAdjunction g dg) (ah : TowerAdjunction h dh)
    (K : T.mateDerived) (n : ℕᵒᵖ) :
    (ev X lX n).map ((towerMate f g h e s ag ah).app (input q K)) ≫
        (evaluatedTarget q dh K n).hom =
      (evaluatedSource q dg K n).hom ≫
        s.exchange.app ((ev T lT n).obj (input q K))
